prompts: Create exactly six isolated pixel-art sprites arranged 3 columns x 2 rows with generous transparent gutters, for the Genshin Impact mechanical boss Watcher: Fallen Vigil, based on the attached Japanese official preview, actual game pose and existing pixel seed. Preserve its faceless nonhuman construct anatomy and silhouette; do NOT turn it into a human or cute child. All body poses face LEFT. Small narrow angular ivory head with one central amber eye, a white three-point feather crescent crown and thin gold halo. Asymmetrical dark charcoal/crimson fragmented torso and floating red-black cube fragments, intact gold arm. ONE huge white feather wing on the VIEWER RIGHT, bearing an angular four-point GOLD shield-eye frame with round amber core. Opposite side only a small feather cluster, not a second giant wing. Long split ivory feather skirt around floating angular red-black lower parts, no human legs/boots. One ornate elongated gold polearm on VIEWER LEFT with crescent blades and red central star ornament. Five complete body poses and one separate star prop: TOP LEFT ready/anticipation floating upright, staff drawn close vertically; TOP CENTER low forward double-lunge follow-through with polearm thrust diagonally LEFT, wing feathers swept backward; TOP RIGHT air preparation holding polearm down-left to throw it vertically into ground, body tilted forward, wing lifted; BOTTOM LEFT Supreme Overseer/charging pose, angular gold eye-shield wing lifted high and open, free hand and polearm raised slightly while recording elements, no surrounding effects; BOTTOM CENTER fallen/downed compact crouched floating posture, head lowered, wing drooping, polearm tilted low but entire weapon in frame; BOTTOM RIGHT just ONE separate small Elemental Star device: an ivory and gold open four-point diamond eye frame surrounding a pale opaque core, on a short pointed floating base, no body, no letters. Consistent same armor/wing/halo/polearm design and common pixel scale across all five bodies. Strong clear chunky pixel clusters, warm dark outlines, gold and ivory with dark crimson accents, not smooth illustration. Transparent alpha outside and in hollow gaps; no fog, colored backdrop, outside glow, shadows, words, UI, labels or grid. Full wing and polearm tips inside each slot.

Create a wide 16:9 original pixel-art 2D side-view game battle background inspired by the attached in-game Watcher: Fallen Vigil arena on Windrest Peak near Dornman Port, Mondstadt. A tranquil outdoor circular ancient stone courtyard adapted into a straight flat side-on fighting platform, light gray worn paving in bottom quarter, pale blue-gray cliff walls and green slopes at back, a few trees along distant edges, tiny grass and low broken stone at the back corners, hazy cool sky and warm afternoon light. Center clear. No people, boss, wings, weapons, large gold devices, star-shaped floor patterns, circles, text, UI, hazard effects or foreground obstructions. Readable muted gray-green-blue palette so ivory/gold boss and red attack markers remain distinct. Crisp pixel textures and parallax-like layers. Entire bottom edge flat and fully covered. This is an independent temporary lab backdrop, not an exact map recreation.
